messages:
megan: Need a tight 1-pager (front/back) for launch: deploy modes, SLAs, security callouts, and a single benchmark nugget for enterprise buyers.
jamal: Keep it short — must work as email blurb, webinar promo, and field leave-behind.
luis: Recommend layout: side A value props + 3-row matrix (Hosted / Dedicated / Private); side B quick-facts, inbound routing, tiny seller scripts.
anna: Field asks: compliance bullets for CISOs, SLA bullets for procurement, and deploy hint for platform leads.
megan: Target audiences: CISO, Platform/DevOps, Procurement. One-line elevator at top.
jamal: Proposed elevator: "Predictable, secure LLM inference across hosted, reserved, and private deployments."
luis: Benchmark nugget suggestion: "P95 latency 120-220ms at 95% utilization on typical chat workloads (dedicated pools)." Add legal: "Internal Redwood labs; results vary by workload."
anna: Inbound labels suggestion: deploy_interest:hosted|dedicated|private, compliance_need:high|medium|low, sla:standard|enterprise. Use simple form routing.
megan: Routing snippet for ops: if deploy_interest == "private" OR compliance_need == "high": tag -> enterprise-sales; elif sla == "enterprise": tag -> enterprise-sales; else: tag -> growth-team.
jamal: Two-line seller scripts: Platform: "Which constraints matter most — isolation, throughput, or residency? Dedicated for sustained throughput; Private for residency/compliance." Security: "We integrate with customer KMS/HSM, provide audit trails and optional on-prem agents for air-gapped ops."
luis: Quick facts (micro): Throughput: Dedicated -> <100ms median token time at 8k windows; Caching: prefix/KV caching reduces token cost ~30% on repeated prompts; Fallbacks: automatic model-variant routing keeps ops <1% error.
anna: Distribution checklist: publish to field assets, add CTAs in trial onboarding, email blast to enterprise segment, webinar promo with demo + Q&A.
megan: Owners & timeline: copy=jamal (Wed noon), benchmarks=luis (Wed 5pm), field quotes=anna (Thu EOD), design=design-team (mock Wed afternoon).
jamal: Final copy will be posted here. Please react :thumbsup: if you agree with routing and plan.
